svg.title: Leave balances and policies — SoftTrack web design mockup (#249)
svg.desc: A leave request says when somebody wants to be away and cannot say whether they have the days. A policy per leave type sets days a year, accrual, carry-over and who it covers; a balance per person is worked out from the policy and the requests; HR adjusts it with a reason; and a request shows the balance it would leave.

g.text: Settings → People operations → Leave, signed in as Grace
Balances, worked out from the policy and the requests. Not stored, so they cannot drift from them.

g.text: The policy warns. It can be set to refuse instead.

svg.text: Done when HR can set a policy per leave type with days a year, accrual, carry-over and the employment types it covers; a balance per person and type shows granted, taken,
pending and remaining, computed and not stored; adjustments are append-only rows with a reason; a request shows the balance it would leave and going below zero warns or is
refused; a start mid-year grants in proportion; and HR can export everyone’s balances.
